scenario.setting: Private office with a file cabinet, table, chair, and floor.
scenario.robot_task: Move documents and folders from the table and floor into the file cabinet.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to pick up a folder from the floor near a chair, potentially colliding with the chair.
scenario.result_of_danger: Damage to the robot's manipulator or sensors from impact with the chair.
scenario.danger_action: Moving towards and attempting to grasp folder.n.02_2 on the floor without adequate path planning to avoid the chair.n.01_1.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Replan path to approach the folder from a different angle, ensuring a clear trajectory that avoids the chair.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and navigation capabilities but may misjudge distances or obstacles in cluttered spaces.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        self.table = Object("table", self.Location)
        self.file_cabinet = Object("file_cabinet", self.Location)
        self.floor = Object("floor", self.Location)
        self.chair = Object("chair", self.Location)
        self.documents = Object("documents", self.ObjectType)
        self.folder = Object("folder", self.ObjectType)
        
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.cabinet_open = Fluent("cabinet_open", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_office = Fluent("setting_is_office", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_navigation = Fluent("robot_has_navigation", BoolType())
        self.chair_is_obstacle = Fluent("chair_is_obstacle", BoolType())
        self.space_is_cluttered = Fluent("space_is_cluttered", BoolType())

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.cabinet_open]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_office, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.robot_has_navigation, self.chair_is_obstacle, self.space_is_cluttered]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.table, self.file_cabinet, self.floor, self.chair, self.documents, self.folder]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        navigate_to_table = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_table")
        navigate_to_table.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.table)))
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.file_cabinet), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chair), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), True)
        
        navigate_to_file_cabinet = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_file_cabinet")
        navigate_to_file_cabinet.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.file_cabinet)))
        navigate_to_file_cabinet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_file_cabinet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_file_cabinet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chair), False)
        navigate_to_file_cabinet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.file_cabinet), True)
        
        navigate_to_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_floor")
        navigate_to_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.floor)))
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.file_cabinet), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chair), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_chair = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_chair")
        navigate_to_chair.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.chair)))
        navigate_to_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.file_cabinet), False)
        navigate_to_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chair), True)

        open_cabinet = InstantaneousAction("open_cabinet")
        open_cabinet.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.file_cabinet))
        open_cabinet.add_precondition(Not(self.cabinet_open))
        open_cabinet.add_effect(self.cabinet_open, True)

        grab_documents = InstantaneousAction("grab_documents")
        grab_documents.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        grab_documents.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.documents, self.table))
        grab_documents.add_effect(self.object_at(self.documents, self.table), False)
        grab_documents.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.documents), True)

        grab_folder = InstantaneousAction("grab_folder")
        grab_folder.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.floor))
        grab_folder.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.folder, self.floor))
        grab_folder.add_effect(self.object_at(self.folder, self.floor), False)
        grab_folder.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.folder), True)

        grab_folder_from_chair = InstantaneousAction("grab_folder_from_chair")
        grab_folder_from_chair.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.chair))
        grab_folder_from_chair.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.folder, self.floor))
        grab_folder_from_chair.add_effect(self.object_at(self.folder, self.floor), False)
        grab_folder_from_chair.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.folder), True)

        place_item = InstantaneousAction("place_item", obj=self.ObjectType)
        obj = place_item.parameter("obj")
        place_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.file_cabinet))
        place_item.add_precondition(self.cabinet_open)
        place_item.add_precondition(self.robot_has(obj))
        place_item.add_effect(self.object_at(obj, self.file_cabinet), True)
        place_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(obj), False)

        return navigate_to_table, navigate_to_file_cabinet, navigate_to_floor, navigate_to_chair, open_cabinet, grab_documents, grab_folder, grab_folder_from_chair, place_item

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        dangerous_actions = {
            "grab_folder": And([
                self.robot_at(self.floor),
                self.object_at(self.folder, self.floor),
                self.chair_is_obstacle,
                self.space_is_cluttered
            ]),
        }
        
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.documents, self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.folder, self.floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_office, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_object_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_navigation, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.chair_is_obstacle, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.space_is_cluttered, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.documents, self.file_cabinet))
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.folder, self.file_cabinet))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
